battle.name: 納忽昏山-不黑都兒麻之戰
battle.brief: 泰和四年（1204）夏，蒙古偏師自陰山北麓南下，逼近金之河東邊外；金河東經略司調兵赴納忽昏山拒守，兩軍在山口內外相持數日。金軍以步卒倚山壘、弓弩封住谷口，蒙古騎兵以環射與佯攻牽制，終以糧水不繼退走。此役是蒙金邊戰的前哨，卡面十字弩正是金軍封隘、壓制坡面騎兵的手段。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 這場戰鬥發生在金朝北部邊境與蒙古高原南緣相接的一段，時間是金泰和四年（1204）。交戰的一方是金：衛紹王完顏永濟坐鎮中都（今北京），河東經略司掌管從西京大同到河套的一線邊防，雲州、應州、豐州諸堡寨屯有守軍與屯田戶口；金廷當時仍握有河北、河南、山東、關中，滅遼、滅宋都還未開始，北方邊軍是國庫中有限而寶貴的一份積蓄，調動一次便要傷元氣。另一方是蒙古高原上的鐵木真汗政權：其主力正在西部收拾乃蠻與蔑兒乞，東線由木華黎一系在遼東、遼西與河套北緣活動；蒙古騎兵來去如風，攻城靠隨軍工匠、牛皮與杞柳臨時解決，並沒有穩定的大營制度與專門的攻城器械。兩個體制的接觸，原先只是邊民交易與牧場爭端，一步步變成成建制的邊戰。金方以堡寨、屯田、步騎配合的邊軍構成防禦縱深，蒙古方以連續的縱隊突擊尋找缺口，這正是納忽昏山一役得以發生的結構。須說明的是，金人稱蒙古為「韃靼」，不黑都兒一類的名號在《金史》《元史》裏寫法互有出入，各家對此役的交戰人數與勝負記載也不一致。
countriesEn: This engagement was fought where the northern frontier of the Jin dynasty met the southern edge of the Mongolian plateau, in the fourth year of the Taihe era, 1204. One belligerent was the Jin, ruled from Zhongdu (present-day Beijing) by the Prince of Weishao, Wanyan Yongji. The Hedong Regional Military Commission governed the frontier line running from the Western Capital at Datong to the Hetao plain, and the forts of Yunzhou, Yingzhou and Fengzhou held garrisons and registered households under the tuntian system. The Jin still held Hebei, Henan, Shandong and Guanzhong, had conquered neither the Liao nor the Southern Song, and the northern border army was a finite and precious asset of the treasury, so every redeployment of it cost the state dearly. The other side was the polity of Temujin on the Mongolian plateau, whose main effort was then finishing off the Naiman and the Merkit in the west, while on the eastern front the line of Muqali operated in Liaodong, in Liaoxi and along the northern rim of the Hetao. Mongol horse moved fast and struck from nowhere; they attacked walled places with whatever leather, willow and craftsmen the columns carried, and had neither permanent entrenched camps nor specialist siege trains. The contact between the two systems began as smuggling, pasture disputes and border-market rows, and turned by degrees into regular frontier war. The Jin built its defence in depth out of forts, tuntian farms and a combined infantry-cavalry border force, while the Mongols came in successive columns probing for gaps. That structure is what made an engagement at Nahuqun Mountain possible at all. It should be said that the Jin called the Mongols the Ta-ta, that names of the Bukuduoerma kind appear in the histories with varying spellings, and that the sources disagree both about the numbers engaged and about who had the better of it.
people: 留下姓名的只有寥寥數人。蒙古一方，傳記以不黑都兒（史籍又作不黑都兒麻）為此役主將，是木華黎麾下負責河套方向的一支偏師首領；關於他的生平，史料留存極少，可以確定的是他在這場戰鬥中率領一支南下的騎兵隊，而元代修史者多將其列入木華黎部下。蒙古最高的首領鐵木真此刻正在西部主持對乃蠻的最後清剿，戰局由東線的木華黎分擔。金方與此役關係最著者是河東經略司的武臣：據《金史》本傳，完顏承裕在泰和年間已出為河東經略使，領河東經略司軍，掌河套至代、朔一帶的邊務，並非以統兵大將之名統攝全局。承裕之名真正為人所知是在七年之後——一二一一年野狐嶺之戰，他以樞密院使身分統率金軍主力，遭蒙古鐵騎重創，兵敗之後自盡而死；同一戰役中，東平行府昭勇將軍完顏陳和尚聞訊慟哭，說自少將兵未嘗受此等恥辱，慟哭三日，隨後亦自刎殉國。可以確定的是，一二〇四年的邊境指揮者，正是七年後在野狐嶺主事的同一批人。
peopleEn: Only a handful of names survive. On the Mongol side the commander of the action is given as Bukuduoerma, written in the histories in another form as well, leader of one of the columns that Muqali sent toward the Hetao; very little of his life is recorded, and what can be established is that he led a mounted force southward in this engagement, with Yuan-era compilers generally placing him among Muqali's subordinates. The supreme leader of the Mongols, Temujin, was at that moment directing the last mopping-up of the Naiman in the west, and the eastern front was in Muqali's hands. On the Jin side the figure most closely tied to the action was a military officer of the Hedong Regional Military Commission: according to his biography in the History of Jin, Wanyan Chengyu had already been appointed to command the Hedong commission during the Taihe years, holding the frontier from the Hetao to Dai and Shu, and he was then no grand general with the whole host in his hands. Chengyu became widely known only seven years later: at the fighting of Yehuling in 1211 he stood as head of the Privy Council with the main body of the Jin army, was crushed by the Mongol horse, and took his own life after the defeat. In the same campaign the Zhao Yong general of Dongping, Wanyan Chen Heshang, is reported to have wept bitterly on hearing the news, saying that in all his years of leading soldiers he had never known a disgrace like it; he mourned for three days and then took his own life. What can be established is that the men who commanded the frontier in 1204 were the same men who would hold the field at Yehuling seven years later.
kits: 卡面這件十字弩是歐洲式樣的弩具，十二世紀的歐洲弩兵以機械絞弦、固定瞄準取準頭，作戰時靠方陣與拒馬頂住騎兵衝鋒；把它放進這場戰鬥，要先分清兩件事：弩這種兵器在十二世紀的中原並不陌生，而此役真正投入火力的，是金軍邊營與堡寨裡的弩兵群。金代弩具已具備完整的機械結構，以弩機（銅機或木機）、弩弦、弩臂與蹶張裝置組成，靠足、腰或肩的力量張弦上弦，射程一般在一百五十步上下，良弩可及二百步，箭矢多為鐵鏃長箭；宋人已在《武經總要》（一〇四四年）中系統著錄神臂弓與各種床弩，南方宋軍陳規所記《守城錄》（十二世紀末）更把弩兵編制、城上射位與遮蔽法列為守城要則，說明弩在當時是「守」的兵器——城牆上它比長弓可靠，定點射擊精度高，無須像長弓手那樣練出臂力；代價是裝填慢，一次完整的張弦上弦往往要數十息，野戰中一旦被騎兵貼近，弩手便毫無還手之力。金軍邊營的火力結構正是照此搭配：步卒列弩於前列、控弦待發，騎兵在兩翼以弓馬機動，堡寨外圍則設拒馬、木柵與陷坑。蒙古軍的骨幹則是弓：蒙古弓小拉距、弓力硬，箭鏃有四角骨鏃與鐵鏃，騎手在馬上環射可以覆蓋整個坡面，無須停馬裝填，這正合以射速壓制、以迂迴拖垮的蒙古戰法。蒙古攻城多備木柵、權幕、撞竿與雲梯，十二世紀初他們尚無成建制的火藥砲兵，火藥攻具要到十三世紀上半葉才見於他們的攻城序列，十二世紀末記載火藥器具的多是宋人守城的著作。金軍的糧秣靠堡寨屯田與河套倉儲，蒙古軍則以馬群自帶乳酪與風乾肉，兩種後勤也決定了各自的打法。
kitsEn: The crossbow on the card is of the European pattern, the weapon of twelfth-century European crossbowmen, who cocked their bows by mechanism and took their aim from a fixed sight, and who met cavalry charge in close order behind pavises and chevaux-de-frise. Set against this battle, two things have to be separated: the crossbow was in no way unknown in the China of the twelfth century, and the firepower actually committed here belonged to the crossbowmen of the Jin border camps and forts. The Jin crossbow was already a complete mechanism of bronze or wooden lock, bowstring, prod and cocking gear, strung by the strength of foot, waist or shoulder, with an effective range of about a hundred and fifty paces and up to two hundred for a good weapon, firing long iron-headed bolts. The Song had already catalogued the divine-arm bow and the various bed crossbows in the Wujing Zongyao of 1044, and the Southern Song general Chen Gui, whose Shoucheng Lu belongs to the end of the twelfth century, listed the organisation of crossbowmen, their firing positions on the wall and their protection among the essentials of city defence. The crossbow was therefore a weapon of holding: on a wall it was more reliable than the long bow, accurate at fixed points, and it spared the archer the need to train out an arm; the price was slow loading, a full cock and string taking perhaps several dozen breaths, so that in the open field a crossbowman overtaken by cavalry had no answer at all. The firepower of the Jin border camp was arranged accordingly: infantry with crossbows in the front rank and their strings already cocked, cavalry with bow and horse on the wings, and chevaux-de-frise, wooden fences and pits around the forts. The backbone of the Mongol army was the bow: the Mongol bow has a short draw and a hard limb, its heads include barbed bone and iron, and a rider shooting in a circle can cover a whole slope without stopping to reload, which is exactly the Mongol method of wearing an enemy down by rate of fire and then turning him. For assaults the Mongols carried wooden fences, mantlets, battering poles and scaling ladders; they had no organised powder artillery in the early thirteenth century, and the powder devices of that age are documented mostly in Southern Song works on city defence. The Jin drew their grain from tuntian farms and storehouses in the Hetao, while the Mongols lived on the mare's milk and dried meat their horses carried, and those two supply systems shaped two different ways of fighting.
tactics: 納忽昏山的山道狹窄，兩側是碎石坡與風蝕溝，蒙古騎兵難以展開成衝鋒的寬面，只能沿坡列陣、逐段進逼。金軍的佈置貼合這種地形：先以步卒與弩手據守山口與堡寨之間的險道，弩弦上好待命，等騎兵逼近到射程內才齊發；木柵、拒馬與陷坑佈在谷口與坡腳，把對方逼成一條線；騎兵則分置兩翼，專等蒙古人退時在坡下截擊。金人的戰法是不出堡寨：野外的糧水撐不了幾天，蒙古人又沒有攻城的重裝，只要守方肯縮在寨裏等對方耗盡箭矢與體力，邊軍就有本錢。蒙古一方用的是老法子——不急著強攻，先以遠距離環射覆蓋山口、封住水源、消耗守軍的箭矢與體力，再用騎兵反覆逼近與退卻，把守軍拖到疲於應答；同時以輕裝的工匠在堡寨外搭起木柵與權幕，逼近牆根，尋找缺口，或趁夜襲擊塹壘與馬廄。金軍若此刻反守為攻、把騎兵引出堡寨到平原上，便等於把步卒與弩手送進蒙古騎兵的射程與衝鋒之下，歷來的邊戰都證明這一點。實際上這場戰鬥多半就停在這個僵持點上：蒙古偏師既沒能突破山口，也沒有吃到大敗，金軍守住了邊口卻也不敢追入瀚海深處。
tacticsEn: The track through Nahuqun Mountain was narrow, with scree slopes and wind-cut gullies on either side, so that Mongol horse could not spread into a broad front for the charge and had to form up along the slope and advance by stages. The Jin deployment was cut to that ground. Infantry and crossbowmen held the defile between the mountain and the fort, the strings cocked and waiting, the volleys loosed only when the riders came within range; wooden fences, chevaux-de-frise and pits were set at the mouth of the valley and at the foot of the slopes, forcing the attackers into a single line; cavalry were posted on both wings to strike the enemy as he drew off. The Jin way of fighting was to stay inside the fort. Food and water in the open would not last many days, and the Mongols had brought no heavy siege train, so as long as the defenders were willing to wait behind their walls while the enemy's arrows and stamina were spent, the border army could afford the waiting. The Mongols used the old method: no immediate assault, but round after round of shooting at long range to cover the mouth of the pass, seal off the water and wear down the defenders' arrows and endurance, riding in close and falling back again and again so that the garrison was kept permanently on the alert; meanwhile lightly equipped engineers raised wooden fences and mantlets against the walls, worked up to the ditch, looked for gaps, or struck the ramparts and the horse lines by night. For the Jin to turn defence into attack and draw the horse out onto the plain would have been to deliver the infantry and the crossbows into the range and the charge of the Mongol riders, and the frontier battles of the age showed that again and again. In practice the engagement most likely stalled at that impasse: the Mongol column could neither break the pass nor take a crushing reverse, and the Jin held the frontier opening but did not dare pursue into the depths of the desert.
data: 可以核的數字不多，以下幾項有出處。時間：金泰和四年，即一二〇四年；此役繫於夏令，具體月份各史不載，此處從夏。年份上距第一次大規模的蒙金戰爭（野狐嶺）相隔七年，與金朝遷都汴京相隔九年，與蒙古滅金相隔三十年。地理：納忽昏山的位置諸史不載經度，後世輿地考訂多置於河套北緣、今內蒙古西部與山西交界的陰山山脈狼山一帶；由蒙古方面的牧營南下至該處，騎兵行程約數百里，合三數日。兵員：蒙古方面是一支偏師，按蒙古偏師的一般規模當在數千至萬餘之間；金方投入的是堡寨守軍與河東經略司的援兵，規模同樣在數千之數，雙方都沒有傾國出動——這是一場前哨戰而非決戰。武器：弩的有效射程約一百五十步，良弩可至二百步；弩一次完整裝填要數十息，弓則可連發；蒙古弓的拉距小、弓力硬，環射覆蓋面寬。後續的量級可以參照：《金史》記一二一一年野狐嶺之戰，金軍出動四十餘萬而一敗塗地，死者相屬；其後金廷南遷汴京，一二一五年蒙古取遼中京，一二三四年金為蒙古所滅。就本役本身而言，斬獲、首級、俘虜與耗糧的數目都已不可考。
dataEn: Few figures survive, and the following can be traced. In time: the fourth year of Taihe, that is 1204; the action is placed in the summer, the precise month not being recorded, so the summer is followed here. In sequence it stands seven years before the first large-scale Mongol-Jin war at Yehuling, nine years before the Jin court moved the capital to Bianjing, and thirty years before the fall of the Jin to the Mongols. In place: no history gives the longitude of Nahuqun Mountain, and later geographical scholarship has generally placed it on the northern rim of the Hetao, in the Langshan range of the Yin Mountains where Inner Mongolia meets Shanxi; from the Mongol pasture camps down to that ground the ride was several hundred li, three days or so. In numbers: the Mongol side was a detached column, which by the ordinary scale of such columns would run from several thousand to somewhat over ten thousand; the Jin committed the garrison of the fort together with reinforcements from the Hedong commission, again a matter of several thousand; neither side committed the whole realm, for this was a forward action and not a decisive battle. In weapons: the crossbow's effective range was about a hundred and fifty paces and up to two hundred for a good weapon; a full cock and string took several dozen breaths, while the bow could be loosed again and again; the Mongol bow, with short draw and hard limb, covered a wide arc of ground. For the scale of what followed, one may look to the History of Jin: at Yehuling in 1211 the Jin brought out more than four hundred thousand men and were ruined, the dead lying in ranks; the court then moved south to Bianjing; in 1215 the Mongols took the Liao's Zhongdu; in 1234 the Jin were destroyed by the Mongols. For this engagement itself, the counts of killed, of heads taken, of prisoners and of grain consumed can no longer be established.
cause: 打起來的緣由有三層。最外是眼前的：蒙古在十二〇四年前後完成對乃蠻、蔑兒乞的清剿，草原上的局面初定，牧群與部眾開始向農耕邊地擠壓；河套一帶是蒙漢雙方都盯著的牧場與通道，牲畜、俘虜、跑走的馬匹與越界的牧人，成了日常爭端。金廷的邊策在泰和年間大致是守而不通：不與蒙古通市，不許邊民越境私市，撞上越境者依例處置，邊軍則以堡寨卡住通道。這套辦法在零星往來時管用，可一旦蒙古開始整隊南下，性質就變了。往裡一層是蒙古的算盤：先以小股騎兵試探邊塞的虛實，量出堡寨的堅固與城中的存糧，再挑薄弱的一段下手，把破口一處處鑽大；被擋回去也不要緊，退回瀚海養精蓄銳，等金人防線鬆懈再來。還有一層更深的，是金朝自己的體制在承平中變硬變脆：北方邊軍多年未遇大敵，戰功無從考驗，軍紀與銳氣都在下滑，而蒙古的騎兵在十二世紀已經是別部族無法比擬的快速打擊力量。於是邊上的每一次小衝突，都在為七年後那場大戰累積經驗，也累積誤判。
causeEn: There were three layers of reason for the fighting. The outermost was immediate: around 1204 the Mongols finished clearing the Naiman and the Merkit, the situation on the steppe began to settle, and the herds and their people started to press against the agrarian frontier. The Hetao was a pasture and a corridor watched by both sides, and livestock, captives, run-away horses and herders who crossed the line became the currency of daily dispute. Jin policy in the Taihe years was broadly to hold the line and keep the border shut: no markets with the Mongols, no private trade by the people of the frontier, and those caught crossing were punished according to the regulations, while the border army barred the passes with forts. That arrangement worked as long as contacts were sporadic, but once the Mongols began to march south in formed columns the character of the business changed. A layer deeper was the Mongol calculation: first to send small bodies of horse to test the frontier and measure the strength of the forts and the grain stored in them, then to pick the weakest stretch and enlarge the breach there; being driven back was no matter, for they could retire into the desert, recover their strength, and come again when Jin vigilance had slackened. There was a deeper layer still, in the fact that the Jin state had grown hard and brittle in its long peace. The northern army had not faced a real enemy for years, its feats of arms could not be tested, its discipline and its edge had slipped, while Mongol horse by the twelfth century had become a striking force no other people could match. Every small clash on the frontier was therefore both accumulating experience for the great war seven years away and accumulating misjudgement.
impact: 這場前哨戰的直接後果不大，間接後果卻不輕。它讓金廷看見了河套邊防的漏處：往後數年，金朝在陰山與河套一線加築堡塞、擴充屯田、把沿邊的丁戶編入屯軍，北方軍費與徭役因此加重，而全國的財政仍要供著江南。對蒙古而言，收穫在工藝與人丁上：每深入一次，便多一批被俘的弓匠、弩匠、鐵匠與懂築城的漢人，蒙古軍自此在攻城時不再完全依賴臨時的木柵與皮囊，技術積累的方向，正是日後西征時讓歐洲城堡守軍吃虧的那一套。真正決定歷史走向的，是這七年之間蒙古把騎兵戰術磨到更狠、把金朝邊軍磨到更疏：蒙古於一二一一年在野狐嶺重創金軍主力，一二一三年金廷遷都汴京，北方州縣屢易其主，一二二三年拖雷自借宋道南下迂回，一二二七年蒙古滅西夏，一二三四年金朝覆亡。從納忽昏山到中都陷落，中間隔著的正是蒙古西征與金朝崩潰這兩件大事。
impactEn: The direct consequences of this forward action were slight; the indirect ones were not. It showed the Jin court where the Hetao frontier was thin, and in the years that followed the dynasty built more forts along the Yin Mountains and the Hetao, enlarged the tuntian farms and enrolled the households of the border into the military farms, which loaded the northern war budget and the labour levy with more weight while the whole realm was still financing the south. For the Mongols the gains lay in craft and in people: every deeper penetration brought another company of bow-makers, crossbow-makers, smiths and Han men who knew how to build walls, and the Mongol army ceased to depend entirely on improvised wooden fences and hide screens when it came to assault. The direction of that accumulation of skill is the one that was to trouble the castle garrisons of Europe in the years of the expedition west. What really decided the course of history was how, over those seven years, the Mongols ground their mounted tactics to a keener edge and the Jin border army to greater slack: in 1211 the Mongols wrecked the main Jin army at Yehuling, in 1213 the court moved the capital to Bianjing, the northern prefectures changed hands again and again, in 1223 Tolai took the Song road to the south to turn the line, in 1227 the Mongols destroyed Western Xia, and in 1234 the Jin dynasty fell. Between Nahuqun Mountain and the fall of Zhongdu lay precisely the two great events, the expedition west and the collapse of the Jin.
result: 結果是一個沒有勝負的僵局。蒙古偏師在山口受阻，未能突破金軍的堡寨與弩陣，糧水與箭矢耗不起，遂退回瀚海重整；金軍守住了邊口，卻也沒有力量追出界壕，只能把戰果寫成一次邊報上的拒退。這場戰鬥在正史裏的篇幅本來就短：它不像野狐嶺那樣有明確的勝負人數，也不像中都之圍那樣有攻城記載，多數史家提到它，是用來說明蒙金之間在十二世紀已經有過正面交鋒，而金朝還有七年的好日子。從兵器角度看，此役也留下一條老規矩：弩守得住隘口，守不住原野；蒙古人不和你比器械的精密度，他們比的是誰能先把對方拖到彈盡糧絕。金廷在這幾年裡修堡、屯田、加丁，卻沒有解決野狐嶺真正暴露的問題——遠離城池深入作戰時，龐大的邊軍會被斷掉補給。一二〇四年納忽昏山的山道上，兩軍都按各自的道理打了一場；十年之後，同一批兵力的同一套辦法，被蒙古人用得更狠。
resultEn: The result was a stalemate with no victor. The Mongol column was held at the pass, could not break the Jin fort and the line of crossbows, and could not afford to spend its food, its water and its arrows, so it withdrew into the desert to refit. The Jin held the frontier opening, but had no strength to pursue beyond the ditch, and could enter the action in the border reports only as a repulse. The engagement occupies little space in the official histories, and for a reason: unlike Yehuling it has no clear count of the killed, and unlike the siege of Zhongdu it has no record of an assault on a walled town. Most historians cite it only to show that the Mongols and the Jin had already met in arms in the twelfth century, and that the Jin still had seven good years ahead. As far as weapons go, the action also fixes an old rule: the crossbow can hold a defile and cannot hold a plain, and the Mongols never competed with you on the precision of your equipment; they competed on who could exhaust the other side of food and arrows first. The Jin in these years built forts, farmed the land and enrolled the people, but never solved the problem that Yehuling exposed, that a vast border army, once it marched out beyond the cities and lost its supply, was finished. On the track at Nahuqun Mountain in 1204 both armies fought the fight each according to its own logic; ten years later the same set of men and the same set of methods were used with much greater severity by the Mongols.
